 ## Common to all three
 
+**Assignee.** When an issue is assigned, the alert event carries two properties:
+
+- `event.properties.assignee` — a JSON string such as `{"type":"user","id":1234}` or `{"type":"role","id":"<role uuid>"}`.
+  It is meant for exact-match filters, not for display.
+- `event.properties.assignee_name` — the user's full name (or email if they have no name) or the role's name.
+  Use this in message text, for example `{event.properties.assignee_name}`.
+
+Both properties are absent when the issue is unassigned, so guard with a conditional such as
+`{event.properties.assignee_name ? event.properties.assignee_name : 'Unassigned'}`.
+
 **Project context** is exposed as `{project.url}` (already includes `/project/<team_id>`), `{project.id}`,
 and `{project.name}`. The alert's own metadata is exposed as `{source.url}` and `{source.name}` —
 useful for "manage this alert" links inside the message body.
